annotations.title: One composed document for a property

description:
Everything we hold about one property, as one document — summary, the
    registered lease, the risk report with every flag three-valued, a rental
    estimate with its basis, the energy picture, and the planning decisions
    nearby. One price for the composition, cheaper than the sections bought
    separately.

    CHECK `sections_degraded` BEFORE SUMMARISING. A section that could not
    answer degrades in place and names the KIND of absence — `not_found`,
    `no_certificate`, `not_available` with its gap, or `error` — and those call
    for different things being said. Report what did not answer rather than
    describing the document as complete.

    Each section is the standalone tool of the same name with the same
    receipts; nothing is computed differently because it is inside a report.
    UK only. Costs 25 credits (25p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
